meta.description: Halka dadka cusubi ay ka helaan saaxiibo cusub kulamada iyo shirarka furry. Waxaa keenay Global Furry Television.
site.name: GFTV HelloSpot
official.line: Website rasmi ah oo ka tirsan Global Furry Television
official.line-short: Website rasmi ah oo GFTV ah
official.domain-heading: Websaydhada rasmiga ah ee GFTV waxay ku dhammaadaan globalfurry.tv ama gftv.asia
official.domain-body: Cinwaanka ka akhri dhammaadkiisa, barta ugu dambeysa ee ka horreysa xarriiqda janjeerta ee keliga ah ee ugu horreysa. Website ku dhammaada wax kale ma aha GFTV, xataa haddii magacu uu ka soo muuqdo meel hore oo cinwaanka ah.
official.trusted-link: Liiska buuxa ee websaydhada rasmiga ah ee GFTV
official.secure-heading: Websaydhada ammaanka ahi waxay isticmaalaan HTTPS
official.secure-body: Raadi calaamadda quf-ka, ama https:// bilowga cinwaanka. Xogtaada gaarka ah ku wadaag oo keliya website rasmi ah oo xiriir ammaan ah leh.

update.ready: Nooc cusub oo GFTV HelloSpot ah ayaa diyaar ah.
hero.card-alt: Kaarka magaca ee HelloSpot. Waxaa ku qoran Hello iyo 哈喽 oo ag yaal dhoolla-caddeyn weyn, dushana ka saaran xarriiqyada qaansoroobaadka ee GFTV.
hero.title: Waxaad heshay HelloSpot!
hero.lede: Kulamada iyo shirarka furry, HelloSpot waa halka dadka cusubi ay ka helaan saaxiibo cusub.
how.title: Sida HelloSpot u shaqeyso
how.spot.title: Raadi dhoolla-caddeynta
how.spot.body: Raadi HelloSmile-ka oo ku yaal kaar, xadhig qoorta lagu xidho ama calaamad. Meel kasta oo uu joogo, halkaasi waa HelloSpot.
how.hello.title: Salaan
how.hello.body: Kaalay oo salaan. Qofna HelloSpot-ka kama filayo inaad hadda qof taqaan.
how.friend.title: Saaxiib samee
how.friend.body: La kulan dadka kugu xeeran, oo la tag qof aad raadiso kulanka xiga.

about.title: Global Furry Television
about.body-1: Global Furry Television (GFTV) waa kanaalka wararka bulshada furry ee ugu weyn Aasiya, xaruntiisuna waa Singapore.
about.body-2: Waxaan soo bandhignaa koritaanka furry si qof kastaa maanta iyo berriba u qaddariyo, waxaanan diyaarinnaa meelo ay dadku wax isaga bartaan oo isku fahmaan.
about.body-3: Laga bilaabo guriga ilaa qaaradaha waaweyn, kooxda GFTV waa caalami, dhaqamo badan iyo luqado badanba leh.
